# Correlation between semantic association implementations and log probability

```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

setwd("experiment3")

exclude_models <- c(
    "Gameselo/STS-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2",
    "bigscience/sgpt-bloom-7b1-msmarco",
    "sentence-transformers/stsb-xlm-r-multilingual"
)

content_pos <- c("NOUN", "VERB", "ADJ", "ADV")
```

```{r}
remove_organization <- function(text) {
    text <- str_remove(text, "Qwen/")
    text <- str_remove(text, "BAAI/")
    text <- str_remove(text, "intfloat/")
    text <- str_remove(text, "bigscience/")
    text <- str_remove(text, "Gameselo/")
    text <- str_remove(text, "jinaai/")
    text <- str_remove(text, "clips/")
    text <- str_remove(text, "sentence-transformers/")
    return(text)
}

# context window of the implementation
get_context_length <- function(implementation) {
    case_when(
        str_detect(implementation, "_sentences1") ~ "Sentence(N=1)",
        str_detect(implementation, "_all") ~ "All",
        .default = "Sentence(N=10)"
    )
}

prepare_df <- function(df) {
    df |>
        filter(pos %in% content_pos) |>
        filter(!model %in% exclude_models) |>
        mutate(context_length = get_context_length(implementation)) |>
        mutate(implementation = str_remove(implementation, "_sentences1|_all")) |>
        mutate(implementation = ifelse(implementation == "prompt", "Prompt", implementation)) |>
        mutate(
            full_implementation = paste(implementation, remove_organization(model), sep = ", ")
        )
}

plot_correlations <- function(df, id_cols, lp_cols) {
    cor_matrix <- df |>
        select(all_of(id_cols), semantic_association, all_of(unname(lp_cols)), full_implementation) |>
        pivot_wider(
            names_from = full_implementation,
            values_from = semantic_association,
            names_prefix = "semantic_association_",
            values_fn = mean # some implementations have duplicated rows
        ) |>
        select(starts_with("semantic_association"), all_of(unname(lp_cols))) |>
        rename(all_of(lp_cols)) |>
        cor(method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

    # Remove prefix
    prefix <- "^semantic_association_"
    colnames(cor_matrix) <- str_remove(colnames(cor_matrix), prefix)
    rownames(cor_matrix) <- str_remove(rownames(cor_matrix), prefix)

    matrix_names <- colnames(cor_matrix)
    name_order <- order(
        case_when(
            str_starts(matrix_names, "Log probability") ~ 1L,
            str_starts(matrix_names, "WE") ~ 2L,
            str_starts(matrix_names, "CWE") ~ 3L,
            str_starts(matrix_names, "SE") ~ 4L,
            str_starts(matrix_names, "Prompt") ~ 5L,
        ),
        matrix_names
    )

    cor_matrix <- cor_matrix[name_order, name_order]
    melted <- melt(cor_matrix)

    melted |>
        filter(as.integer(Var1) > as.integer(Var2)) |>
        ggplot(aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
        geom_tile() +
        geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 2)), color = "black", size = 3) +
        scale_fill_gradient2(
            low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white",
            midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1, 1)
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
        ) +
        labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "Pearson's r") +
        theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
}
```

## DERCo
```{r}
derco_df <- read.csv(file.path("results", "derco_semantic_association_wprompt.csv")) |>
    select(-X) |>
    prepare_df()
```

```{r}
context_window <- "Sentence(N=10)" # "Sentence(N=1)" or "All"

derco_df |>
    filter(context_length == context_window) |>
    plot_correlations(
        id_cols = c("article_n", "word_n"),
        lp_cols = c("Log probability, Pythia" = "lp_pythia")
    ) +
    labs(caption = context_window)

ggsave(
    file.path("figs", paste0("derco_correlations_", context_window, ".png")),
    width = 9, height = 7
)
```
